authorFamilyNote: authorFamilies names the company that wrote the pull request, when the GitHub login is enough to know. claude[bot] (Claude Code) is anthropic, so Grill CI excludes Anthropic. chatgpt-codex-connector[bot] (Codex) is openai, so Grill CI excludes OpenAI. An empty string means the login does not name a writing model: mtangoz, cursor[bot], cursoragent, and any other login. A line 'Written-by-model: <vendor>/<model>' is honoured for every such author and excludes that vendor. With no such line, nothing is excluded. The judge is always OpenRouter's Auto Router (openrouter/auto); Grill CI does not pin a model. After the run, Grill CI checks the served model's vendor. If that vendor was excluded, the comment is marked NOT decorrelated, the pull request gets needs-review, and the job fails. When the author model is unknown, the comment says so, independence isn't verified, and it suggests adding a Written-by-model line.
